## Data Loading
Trying to load some data, first start by installing packages 
```{r}
install.packages("baseballr") #open-source R package 
install.packages("tidyverse") 
library(baseballr)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
install.packages("remotes") #install package from non-standard locations
remotes::install_github("BillPetti/baseballr") #install off github 
```
Run a quick test, get Statcast pitch-level data 
```{r}
test <- statcast_search(start_date = "2024-04-01", end_date = "2024-04-07")
nrow(test)
```
```{r}
pitcher_ids <- c(
  "Gerrit Cole"     = 543037,
  "Kevin Gausman"   = 592332,
  "Logan Webb"      = 657277,
  "Zack Wheeler"    = 554430,
  "Sandy Alcantara" = 645261
)
```
```{r}
# Generate week-by-week date ranges for 2024 season
start_dates <- seq(as.Date("2024-04-01"), as.Date("2024-09-25"), by = "7 days")
end_dates   <- pmin(start_dates + 6, as.Date("2024-09-29"))

date_ranges <- tibble(start = start_dates, end = end_dates)

# Pull each week, filter to your pitchers, keep only FF (four seam fastball)
fetch_week <- function(start_dt, end_dt) {
  message("Pulling: ", start_dt, " to ", end_dt)
  
  df <- tryCatch({
    statcast_search(
      start_date  = as.character(start_dt),
      end_date    = as.character(end_dt),
      player_type = "pitcher"
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("  Error: ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # Filter to your pitchers and four-seam fastballs only
  df <- df %>%
    filter(
      pitcher %in% pitcher_ids,
      pitch_type == "FF"
    )
  
  Sys.sleep(3)
  return(df)
}

# Pull all weeks — this will take several minutes
raw_data <- map2_dfr(date_ranges$start, date_ranges$end, fetch_week)
```
```{r}
# sanity check 
raw_data %>%
  group_by(player_name) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pitches = n(),
    n_games   = n_distinct(game_pk),
    date_min  = min(game_date),
    date_max  = max(game_date)
  )
```
